minimum_pass: net PnL > 0 after fees where feasible
caution: positive before fees or only slightly positive after fees
why: Active trading must beat no-trade after costs.

minimum_pass: PF >= 1.10 by default unless a stricter hypothesis-specific gate is set
why: PF below 1 shows negative active trade profile.

minimum_pass: drawdown controlled and justified by returns; not materially worse than reference risk without compensation
caution: drawdown expands while returns are marginal
fail: drawdown not compensated by return or operationally unacceptable

minimum_pass: BTCUSDT net PnL >= 0 and PF >= 1.05 for BTC-relevant strategy, or explicit non-BTC framing before test
caution: BTC weak but hypothesis is not BTC-centered
why: BTC failure was decisive for the parked candidate and is serious for this project.

minimum_pass: For 19-market basket, at least 10/19 positive markets by default
caution: 8-9 positive markets or many flat/no-trade markets
why: Avoid a candidate that only works in isolated markets.

minimum_pass: top 3 market contribution <= 75%, top 5 <= 100%, top 10 positive trades <= 65% when aggregate positive
caution: positive but concentration above pass bands
fail: aggregate negative or top 3 >= 90% / top 10 trades >= 80%
why: Positive aggregate is weak if it relies on a few markets or trades.

minimum_pass: Must beat failed Long1-only holdout and D2/D6 caution references without reopening Long1-only
caution: improves one reference but not no-trade/BTC/breadth gates
fail: resembles or underperforms failed Long1-only or dry-run references
why: New work must improve on known failures.

minimum_pass: For BTC-relevant strategy, active results should be compared to passive BTC risk/return over same window
caution: beats no-trade but underperforms passive BTC on risk-adjusted basis
fail: active trading loses while passive/no-trade alternatives are superior
why: Opportunity cost matters, but negative-edge activity is worse than no-trade.
